short_description: Consumer-facing appearance trait that reports a cautious panel-relative signal for skin tanning tendency after sun exposure within the current local reference panel.
summary_note: Usable consumer-facing appearance trait with practical raw-array support and a clearer interpretation boundary between inherited tanning tendency and real-world sun exposure for the no-imputation workflow.
what_it_measures: A panel-relative polygenic signal associated with a tendency toward mild or occasional skin tanning after sun exposure, calibrated within the current local empirical reference panel.
interpretation_template: Skin tanning tendency is presented here as a cautious relative appearance signal, not a direct prediction of how your skin will look in everyday conditions. {interpretation}
caution_text: Use as a cautious panel-relative signal only. No imputation or ancestry-adjusted normalization is used, and the output should not be treated as a deterministic real-world result or as a direct prediction of visible tanning outcome.
limitations: Percentiles and z-scores are relative to the local reference panel, not to a population-wide benchmark.

Visible tanning outcome also depends strongly on sun exposure, sunscreen use, season, latitude, and baseline skin pigmentation, so this should not be treated as a deterministic prediction of real-world tanning outcome.
confidence_note: Confidence reflects overlap and reference robustness under the no-imputation raw-array workflow, not certainty about the real-world trait.
reference_note: Percentiles and z-scores are calibrated against a local empirical reference artifact built from raw-array files in this project; they are panel-relative, not population-wide.
